''See also: [[Striker technique Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[Striker]] [[technique]] is a method of combat used by [[sacred artists]] to project power outward, typically through an individual attack. While [[Enforcer techniques]] focus on enhancing a single motion or movement, [[Striker techniques]] are characterized by their ability to launch energy—such as light, fire, or elemental [[madra]]—away from the user's body. These techniques can vary significantly in complexity and power, ranging from simple thrusts and pulses of [[madra]] to highly advanced manifestations that carry a living will or act with the autonomy of a [[spirit]]. In practice, [[Striker techniques]] can take many forms: they may appear as beams of light, projectiles like birds or serpents, waves of energy, or even liquid-like substances. They are often used to attack from a distance, disrupt an opponent's [[madra channels]], or follow up on other movements. While they can be incredibly lethal and capable of devastating environments, using them often requires specific [[cycling]] patterns to build power before release. Some advanced users can coordinate multiple techniques simultaneously or integrate them with sacred instruments and weapons to create more complex, multi-step attacks.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The [[Striker]] [[technique]] is a specific type of [[technique]] utilized by [[Mu Enkai|Enkai]] and [[Ekeri]]. == Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|[[Striker techniques]] are combat methods that function by projecting [[madra]]. These attacks possess enough power to tear a person in half, and they can be successfully landed even from the top of a pillar. While such techniques can be caught by a bronze plate or deflected by [[Yerin]], they are also integral components of more complex layering techniques. Such advanced maneuvers may require the simultaneous use of a [[Forger technique]], a [[Striker]] [[technique]], and a [[Ruler technique]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Striker]] is a specific category of [[technique]] that can be imbued with a living will. While these techniques are utilized by enemies during battle and by Overlords to intervene in duels, they present a risk where attackers may hit one another if used improperly. During the conflict, [[Yan Shoumei]] deployed a red [[needle]] [[Striker]] [[technique]], and the [[Blood Sage]] also launched one toward [[Yerin]]. Although [[Yerin]]'s own [[Striker]] [[technique]] was deemed acceptable by the [[Winter Sage]], it was not considered worth further development. In response to these attacks, [[Eithan]]'s [[Hollow King’s Mantle]] demonstrated the ability to hurl a [[Striker]] [[technique]] back at its source.}}

These techniques can be used to push targets with force or inflict the illusion of pain. During various conflicts, [[Security constructs|security constructs]], bystanders, and the [[Jai Matriarch|Matriarch]] have all utilized these abilities.
